title: PresenceUserConfigUser - Data API
description: Represents a configuration that determines the settings that are assigned to a presence user. These user-level configurations override profile-level configurations. This object is available in API version 32.0 and later.

PresenceUserConfigId.description: The ID of the presence configuration.

UserId.description: The ID of the user who’s associated with this presence configuration. A user can be associated with only one presence configuration.

special_access_rules:
To access this object, Omni-Channel must be enabled. As of Spring ’20 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.
